subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While a feature draft is open, the system shall show, as a non-blocking notice, the other open proposals that the repository memory reports touching the same requirements or decisions.
rationale: Memory's existing in-flight warning stays a free heads-up (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-22)
fit_criterion: In a fixture with two open drafts sharing a requirement, each shows the other in a notice that blocks nothing.
